quests.name: Dwarven Outfitters
quests.text: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.

quests.name: Simple Rune
quests.text: Read the Simple Rune and speak to Thran Khorman in Coldridge Valley.
notes: The rune is given when you accept; don't destroy it, it is needed for the turn-in.

quests.name: Consecrated Rune
quests.text: Read the Consecrated Rune and speak to Bromos Grummner in Coldridge Valley.

quests.name: Etched Rune
quests.text: Read the Etched Rune and speak to Thorgas Grimson in Coldridge Valley.

quests.name: Encrypted Rune
quests.text: Read the Encrypted Rune and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.
notes: The rune is handed over when you accept the quest. It is only a rogue class letter, so there is nothing to farm.

quests.name: Hallowed Rune
quests.text: Read the Hallowed Rune and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.

quests.name: Simple Memorandum
quests.text: Read the Simple Memorandum and speak to Thran Khorman in Coldridge Valley.

quests.name: Encrypted Memorandum
quests.text: Read the Encrypted Memorandum and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.

quests.name: Glyphic Memorandum
quests.text: Read the Glyphic Memorandum and speak to Marryk Nurribit inside Anvilmar above Coldridge Valley.
notes: Mage-only class quest. The memorandum is handed to you when you accept and must be in your bags at turn-in.

quests.name: Tainted Memorandum
quests.text: Read the Tainted Memorandum and speak to Alamar Grimm inside Anvilmar above Coldridge Valley.

quests.name: Welcome!
quests.text: Bring the Coldridge Valley Gift Voucher to Yori Crackhelm.

quests.name: Hallowed Memorandum
quests.text: Read the Hallowed Memorandum and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.

quests.name: Archaic Rune
quests.text: Read the Archaic Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

quests.name: A New Threat
quests.text: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.

quests.name: The Boar Hunter
quests.text: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.

quests.name: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery
quests.text: Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye.

quests.name: A Refugee's Quandary
quests.text: Bring Felix's Box, Felix's Chest and Felix's Bucket of Bolts to Felix Whindlebolt in Anvilmar.

quests.name: The Troll Cave
quests.text: Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps.

quests.name: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery
quests.text: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard.
notes: On Forever this quest gives no money. Instead you choose one of three profession books as the reward.

quests.name: Beginnings
quests.text: Bring 3 Feather Charms to Alamar Grimm in Anvilmar.

quests.name: Call of Earth
quests.text: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

quests.name: Call of Earth
quests.text: Find the Spirit Stone and drink the Earth Sapta.

quests.name: Earth Sapta
quests.text: Speak to Teo Hammerstorm for another Earth Sapta.

quests.name: Garments of the Light
quests.text: Find Mountaineer Dolf and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos.

quests.name: In Favor of the Light
quests.text: Speak to Maxan Anvol in Dun Morogh.

quests.name: The Stolen Journal
quests.text: Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.

quests.name: Senir's Observations
quests.text: Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.

quests.name: Senir's Observations
quests.text: Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

quests.name: Supplies to Tannok
quests.text: Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.

quests.name: Tools for Steelgrill
quests.text: Deliver Steelgrill's Tools to Beldin Steelgrill.

quests.name: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery
quests.text: Take a Scalding Mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar before it gets cold in five minutes!
notes: The quest and the mornbrew both expire after 5 minutes, so go straight to Durnan. The run takes about a minute.

quests.name: Bring Back the Mug
quests.text: Return Nori's Mug to Nori Pridedrift.

quests.name: Bitter Rivals
quests.text: In the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, replace a barrel of Thunder Ale with a Barrel of Barleybrew Scalder.

quests.name: Stocking Jetsteam
quests.text: Gather 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs, and deliver them to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

quests.name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
quests.text: Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
quests.text: Speak with Tognus Flintfire in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Mining
quests.text: Speak with Yarr Hammerstone in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: First Aid
quests.text: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Fishing
quests.text: Speak with Paxton Ganter near Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Herbalism
quests.text: Speak with Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Skinning
quests.text: Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Tailoring
quests.text: Speak with Uthrar Threx in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Engineering
quests.text: Speak with Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: The Great Outdoors
quests.text: Sit near Eric's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

quests.name: The Adventurer
quests.text: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.
notes: Thalos gives you the Supply Bundle when you accept. Don't delete it, because it is the item you hand in.

quests.name: Camping 101: Cooking
quests.text: Speak with Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos to learn to become a cook.

quests.name: Grund and Gozwin
quests.text: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.

quests.name: Ammo for Rumbleshot
quests.text: Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.

quests.name: Return to Marleth
quests.text: Bring the barrel of Thunder Ale to Marleth Barleybrew at the Brewnall Village.
notes: The quest comes from a barrel object in the distillery cellar, not from an NPC. The Thunder Ale barrel is given when you accept.

quests.name: Evershine
quests.text: Get a cask of Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.

quests.name: The Grizzled Den
quests.text: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.

quests.name: Flintfire's Shipment
quests.text: Collect 8 Flintfire Shipments from the Grizzled Den for Tongus Flintfire in Kharanos.

quests.name: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
quests.text: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.

quests.name: A Favor for Evershine
quests.text: Kill 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars, and 8 Snow Leopards, and then return to Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.

quests.name: Return to Bellowfiz
quests.text: Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

quests.name: Secure the Mountain
quests.text: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.

quests.name: Secure the Mountain
quests.text: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.

quests.name: Secure the Mountain
quests.text: Deliver Mountaineer Gretchen's Report back to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

quests.name: Dawn in the Mountains
quests.text: Bring the crate of candles to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge.

quests.name: Finding Warmth
quests.text: Collect 14 pieces of firewood.

quests.name: Rime's Wrath
quests.text: Destroy 10 minor ice elementals.

quests.name: Rime's Wrath
quests.text: Kill Avala and retrieve its core.

quests.name: Treacherous Cold
quests.text: Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers.

quests.name: The Perfect Stout
quests.text: Bring 6 Shimmerweeds to Rejold Barleybrew in the Brewnall Village.

quests.name: Those Blasted Troggs!
quests.text: Kill 6 Rockjaw Skullthumpers for Foreman Stonebrow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.

quests.name: Frosthowl
quests.text: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village.

quests.name: Frostmane Hold
quests.text: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

quests.name: The Reports
quests.text: Deliver Senir's report to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge.

quests.name: Operation Recombobulation
quests.text: Bring Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears.

quests.name: Data Hoarders
quests.text: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.

quests.name: Never Saddle on Quality
quests.text: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.

quests.name: Stolen Blasting Powder
quests.text: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten at Gol'Bolar Quarry.
notes: The quest starts from a keg that Rockjaw troggs drop, so you won't find it at a quest giver.

quests.name: Stolen Blasting Powder
quests.text: Recover 16 Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.

quests.name: The Quarry's Smith
quests.text: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.

quests.name: Shimmer Stout
quests.text: Take the Barrel of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Barleybrew.

quests.name: Stout to Kadrell
quests.text: Take the Cask of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Kadrell.

quests.name: Rejold's New Brew
quests.text: Speak with Rejold Barleybrew.

quests.name: The Lost Pilot
quests.text: Find Pilot Hildelve.

quests.name: Muren Stormpike
quests.text: Speak with Muren Stormpike.

quests.name: Speak with Bink
quests.text: Speak with Bink in Ironforge.

quests.name: Road to Salvation
quests.text: Speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard in Ironforge.

quests.name: Onin's Report
quests.text: Take Onin's Report back to Hulfdan in Ironforge.

quests.name: Returning Home
quests.text: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.

quests.name: Desperate Prayer
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Large Crag Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

quests.name: The Hunter's Path
quests.text: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice Claw Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

quests.name: Training the Beast
quests.text: Speak with Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Hunter's Path
quests.text: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

quests.name: Divine Grace
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

quests.name: Confounding Flash
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

quests.name: Confounding Flash
quests.text: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Public Servant
quests.text: Kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers for Senator Mehr Stonehallow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.

quests.name: A Pilot's Revenge
quests.text: Kill Mangeclaw.  Bring his Mangy Claw and Hildelve's Journal to Pilot Hammerfoot.

quests.name: Call of Fire
quests.text: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Protecting the Herd
quests.text: Rudra Amberstill wants you to slay Vagash and bring his fang to her at the Ram ranch.

quests.name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
quests.text: Retrieve Tundra MacGrann's dried meats from the stolen meat locker in Old Icebeard's cave.

quests.name: Tome of Divinity
quests.text: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.

quests.name: Nip 'Em in the Bud
quests.text: Slay 10 Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.

quests.name: Farsen's Watch
quests.text: Speak with Earthseer Farsen and ask him to lend you his far sight to observe the Dark Iron threat.
notes: The objective counts as a kill credit on Farsen himself, but you get it from his gossip far sight, not by fighting him.

quests.name: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
quests.text: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

quests.name: The Tome of Divinity
quests.text: Retrieve a Dark Iron Script from the Dark Iron dwarves near Helm's Bed, and return to Muiredon Battleforge in Ironforge.

quests.name: Underground Map
quests.text: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.

quests.name: The Treaty of Understanding
quests.text: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

quests.name: To Hulfdan!
quests.text: Travel to Ironforge and speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard.

quests.name: Search for Incendicite
quests.text: Bring 6 loads of Incendicite Ore to Pilot Stonegear in Dun Morogh.

quests.name: The Test of Righteousness
quests.text: Using Jordan's Weapon Notes, find some Whitestone Oak Lumber, Bailor's Refined Ore Shipment, Jordan's Smithing Hammer, and a Kor Gem, and return them to Jordan Stilwell in Ironforge.
notes: The lumber and hammer are inside the Deadmines and Shadowfang Keep dungeons, so you will probably need a group.

quests.name: The Test of Righteousness
quests.text: Wait for Jordan Stilwell to finish forging a weapon for you.

quests.name: Stonegear's Search
quests.text: Speak with Pilot Stonegear.

quests.name: Save Techbot's Brain!
quests.text: Bring Techbot's Memory Core to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

quests.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
quests.text: Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

quests.name: Gnogaine
quests.text: Use the Empty Leaden Collection Phial on Irradiated Invaders or Irradiated Pillagers to collect radioactive fallout. Once it is full, take it back to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.
notes: Irradiated Invader is an elite mob.

quests.name: The Day After
quests.text: Speak with Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.

quests.name: Castpipe's Task
quests.text: Speak with Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.

quests.name: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators
quests.text: Bring twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
quests.text: Travel to Gnomeregan and bring back High Potency Radioactive Fallout. Be warned, the fallout is unstable and will collapse rather quickly.  Ozzie will also require your Heavy Leaden Collection Phial when the task is complete.
notes: The fallout disappears after 2 hours, so hearth back and hand it in quickly.

quests.name: A Fine Mess
quests.text: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Essential Artificials
quests.text: Bring 12 Essential Artificials to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.

quests.name: Klockmort's Essentials
quests.text: Speak with Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.

quests.name: Data Rescue
quests.text: Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.
notes: The 3005-D terminal is deep inside the Gnomeregan dungeon, so you need a group.

quests.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
quests.text: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
notes: The machine takes 3 silver at turn-in. Mobs inside the dungeon are mostly elites.

quests.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
quests.text: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

quests.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
quests.text: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

quests.name: More Sparklematic Action
notes: The objects drop inside the Gnomeregan dungeon, so a group is advised.

quests.name: Grime-Encrusted Ring
quests.text: Figure out a way to remove the grime from the Grime-Encrusted Ring.

quests.name: Return of the Ring
quests.text: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.

quests.name: Return of the Ring
quests.text: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.

quests.name: Chief Engineer Scooty
quests.text: Speak with Scooty in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Gnomer-gooooone!
quests.text: Wait for Scooty to calibrate the Goblin Transponder.

quests.name: Rig Wars
quests.text: Retrieve the Rig Blueprints and Thermaplugg's Safe Combination from Gnomeregan and bring them to Nogg in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Grand Betrayal
quests.text: Venture to Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque when the task is complete.
notes: Thermaplugg is an elite final boss in a dungeon, so you need a group.

quests.name: Your First Riding Ram
quests.text: Inspect the riding rams to choose your first mount.

quests.name: Learning to Ride
quests.text: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Ultham Ironhorn.

quests.name: Your First Mechanostrider
quests.text: Inspect the riding mechanostriders to choose your first mount.

quests.name: Learning to Ride
quests.text: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Binjy Featherwhistle.

quests.name: Goldwell the Elder
notes: You can only get this quest while the Lunar Festival world event is running.

quests.name: Honoring a Hero
quests.text: Travel to Uther's Tomb in Western Plaguelands and use Uther's Tribute at his statue, and then return to Wagner Hammerstrike outside Ironforge before the Harvest Festival is over.

quests.name: Swift as the Wind
quests.text: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Binjy Featherwhistle.

quests.name: Swift as the Wind
quests.text: Learn the Journeyman Riding skill from Ultham Ironhorn.
